name: Hanameel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Hanameel his uncle's son came to Jeremiah in the court of the prison to sell him the field at Anathoth, for the right of redemption and inheritance was Jeremiah's; then he knew it was the word of the Most High.

note.label: Jeremiah 32: Buying the Field of Redemption
